content.query:
--Alter
ALTER TABLE BNKM.CustomerOnlineBankingUserLoginAccess
ADD SourceSystemCode varchar(50) NOT NULL

ALTER TABLE BNKM.CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
ADD SourceSystemCode varchar(50) NOT NULL

ALTER TABLE BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty
ADD SourceSystemCode varchar(50) NOT NULL

ALTER TABLE BNKM.FinancialProductSubscriptionRelatedEmployee
ADD SourceSystemCode varchar(50) NOT NULL

--Checking
SELECT TABLE_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('CustomerOnlineBankingUserLoginAccess', 'CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus', 'CustomerRelatedParty', 'FinancialProductSubscriptionRelatedEmployee')
AND COLUMN_NAME = 'SourceSystemCode' 


--Additional
ALTER TABLE BUSC.CRM_DELETEDCIF
ADD SOURCE_CODE varchar(50) NOT NULL

SELECT TABLE_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('CRM_DELETEDCIF')
AND COLUMN_NAME = 'SOURCE_CODE'
